thread:
Maria Chen: Quick sync — we need a tight rubric for prioritizing design partner / beta invites for Private Deploy. Goal: ~8 partners, staggered, high-signal feedback in first 6 weeks. Thoughts?
AJ Patel: +1. Can we be explicit about what ‘high-signal’ means? e.g., integration complexity, number of users, SLA needs.
Sophie Park: Agree. Suggest scoring across 5 axes: fit, impact, technical fit, resourcing, and feedback capacity. Keep weights explicit.
Ken O'Neill: Also include legal/compliance gating — some customers will require on-prem or specific controls, that affects scope.
Jake Rivers: From eng POV, technical fit matters a lot. Customers with existing infra (+K8s + GPU infra) are easier for Private. Score them higher.
Elena Gomez: We should avoid making the rubric purely technical. Customers that will commit to regular check-ins and provide annotated logs are gold.
Maria Chen: Draft rubric I used in last pilot, adapted: 
```
- Strategic fit (20%): product alignment + potential long tail benefit
- Technical integration complexity (25%): infra, data flows, security
- Feedback availability (20%): cadence commits, designated SEs, test plans
- Business impact (15%): revenue influence / references
- Operational risk (20%): legal, compliance, data sensitivity
```
Maria Chen: Scoring 1-5 per axis, multiply by weight, pick top 8. Can we add a quick mandatory checkbox: 'can run pilot within 30d'?
AJ Patel: Add that as a gating question not scored — must be yes. Also add 'no conflicting NDAs' checkbox.
Sophie Park: For recruitment messaging, we should set expectations: 3-week onboarding, 6-week feedback window, and one integration week afterwards. Call it "6+1".
Ken O'Neill: Ops note: ensure we have a fallback model variant (smaller memory) for customers with limited GPU. Documented in the tech playbook.
Jake Rivers: I'll add a short runbook for minimal infra (single-GPU dev config) and a 'fast-forward' mode for testing.
Elena Gomez: Success criteria proposal: 
- Engagement: >=75% of scheduled sessions completed
- Issue signal: >=10 unique, actionable bugs/observations per partner in first 6 weeks
- Adoption: one partner converts to pilot/reserved within 90 days
- Quality: no major regression in our model evals tied to their prompts

Maria Chen: Those look good. Can we add a lightweight eval suite to be run monthly by partners? Makes regressions visible.
AJ Patel: Yes — small prompt set (30 prompts) + automated diffs. We should version it per partner to capture their domain.
Sophie Park: Feedback loop: weekly async notes + biweekly 60m review call. We should require a dedicated product contact from partner.
Ken O'Neill: Who will own rollout decisions? Product PMs should own gating; eng to sign off on infra and SRE on reliability. Add Legal for contract gates.
Maria Chen: Proposed launch gates (must pass all): 
- Contract signed w/ pilot terms (Legal)
- Infra validated test run (Eng)
- Onboarding sessions scheduled (Customer Success)
- Eval harness baseline recorded (Research/QA)
- Rollback plan & fallback models documented (SRE)

Elena Gomez: Recommend a 'risk tier' label on each partner (low/medium/high) so we can prioritize SRE attention.
Jake Rivers: I'll own creating the 'minimal infra' runbook and a quick test matrix. ETA: EOW.
AJ Patel: I'll work with Legal on a pilot addendum template that covers data, logs, and rollback.
Sophie Park: I'll draft the recruitment email + commitment checklist. Want to keep message short: "6+1 beta: 6 weeks feedback + 1 week integration. Weekly async + biweekly calls. Need 2 eng contacts and 1 product contact."
Maria Chen: Nice. Also add incentives: $5k engineering credit or co-marketing for successful pilots. Keep flexible.
Elena Gomez: For feedback capture, recommend a simple Google sheet + shared Slack channel per partner. We should define the template: bug type, severity, step-to-repro, KPI impact.
Ken O'Neill: Ops: tag all partner infra in our monitoring dashboard and add a 72h alert SLA for high severity.
Maria Chen: Next steps: 
- Jake: minimal infra runbook (EOW)
- AJ: pilot addendum draft (Tue)
- Sophie: recruitment message + intake form (Tue)
- Elena: feedback template + success metric dashboard (Wed)
- Ken: SRE/monitoring checklist (Wed)
We'll reconvene Thu 11am to finalize rubric and seed list.
AJ Patel: Ack. I'll pull candidate list and score them with the rubric template.
Sophie Park: I'll mock up the intake form with the gating checkboxes.
Maria Chen: Thanks all — please post updates in this thread. :thumbsup:
